subject: english
question: **Select the sentences that contains no spelling errors.**

options.text: I saw the dress catalouge pieces of Asha’s corchiture collection.
I saw the dress catalougue pieces of Asha’s couture collection.
I saw the dress catalougue pieces of Asha’s corchiture collection.
I saw the dress catalogue pieces of Asha’s couture collection.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'I saw the dress catalogue pieces of Asha’s couture collection.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence that has all the correct spellings is* 'I saw the dress catalogue pieces of Asha’s couture collection'.*
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"catalogue"** not** "catalouge", **and the correct spelling of the word **"couture" **is not **"corchiture"**. Therefore,** sentences 2 and 3** both have spelling errors.
 
• The correct spelling of the words in **sentence 1** and **sentence 4** is different.
 
• Therefore, the only sentence that contains no spelling errors is **sentence 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *I saw the dress catalogue pieces of Asha’s couture collection.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• catalogue- A complete list of things, usually arranged systematically
 
• couture- the designing and making of expensive fashionable clothes, or the clothes themselves
